messages:
maria: Heads up — console preflight sampling shows a spike of 413s for mixed-dim embeds from mobile clients. Telemetry totals don't match the quota meter :eyes:
kevin: Seen similar. Are these rejects coming from the splitter or runtime? Any stack traces?
maria: Looks like splitter is returning 413 when payload > 5MB. But many clients never include dims header so splitter doesn't split. Example headers we've seen:

```
X-Embed-Dims: 1536
Content-Length: 6123456
X-Client-Sdk: mobile/1.4.2
```

Some SDKs send `X-Embed-Dims: auto` which our preflight can't parse.
sarah: Can we add a console panel for "missing dims" counts? Right now quota meter is byte-based and hides dim-related rejections.
ray: FYI our preflight sampler currently drops events for chunked requests; we sample 1/100 by default. That will make aggregated numbers diverge from raw quota logs.
ana: (typo: meant ana) ana: Proposal: emit a small, high-fidelity sampled event for preflight mismatches with fields: sample_id, tenant_id (opaque), reason e.g. `dims_missing` and `payload_too_big`. Also compute `embed_units` = dims * num_items so console can show unit-based vs byte-based billing.
kevin: Concern: new high-cardinality fields will increase telemetry throughput cost. We should SLO the pipeline and use deterministic sampling keys so we can de-dupe.
sarah: UI ask: for rollouts we need per-tenant preflight mismatch rate so support can triage. Is exposing tenant_id ok? (we should keep opaque ids)
ray: tenant_id already exists as an opaque string in internal events. I'll add `sample_id` and `reason` to the sampled preflight events. No PII.
deploy-bot: deploy: telemetry-service v2.17 -> staging (preflight-sampler=1/10) :rocket:
ana: (again ana) ana: runtime change: make splitter fast-fail with a clear machine-readable header `X-Embed-Error: dims_missing` so SDKs can fallback and set dims header client-side.
kevin: +1. I'll open runtime PR for the `X-Embed-Error` header and add a console mapping to surface the human-friendly message. Also will update SDK to set dims where possible. :thumbsup:
maria: I'll draft a short support playbook and a GA rollout plan: start 10% tenants, monitor the preflight match rate variance < 1% vs raw quota logs before 100% rollout.

ray: Sample telemetry prototype (staging):

```
{
  "sample_id": "s1234abcd",
  "tenant_id": "t-9f3b",
  "reason": "dims_missing",
  "dims": null,
  "bytes": 6123456,
  "embed_units": null,
  "request_ts": 1768888888
}
```

kevin: let's sync tomorrow 10:30 to decide SLOs and the console panel layout.
maria: SGTM. Thanks team.
